# Hedge 3
Trim hedges and potted plants into marvelous new shapes with any old knife. Not applicable to plastic plants.
## Using it 1. Hold a [color=#a4885c]sharp item[/color].\n2. Click a potted plant and stand still for a moment while you trim it.
[color=#a4885c]Cosmetic.[/color] Without the chip the same click [color=#a4885c]stashes[/color] the item inside the plant as usual.
## Notes The new shape is random.\nMoving cancels the trim.
